record.title: China’s 2026–2030 agriculture plan sets policy directions for AI, datasets and compute
record.summary: China’s State Council 2026–2030 agricultural and rural modernization plan directs faster agricultural AI innovation and application, expansion of application scenarios, agricultural/rural data infrastructure and large, multimodal, high-quality datasets with data standards. It also calls for domestic-software and hardware development, improved computing capacity and an integrated sky–air–ground agricultural observation network. The Ministry of Agriculture’s page is dated 2026-09-07 and says the online text is abridged; the notice itself states that the State Council issued the plan on 2026-05-26. These are central policy directions, not funded commitments, local deployments or measured effects.
organizations: State Council of the People’s Republic of China
Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: The Ministry of Agriculture page dated 2026-09-07 publishes a State Council notice stating that the 2026–2030 agricultural and rural modernization plan was issued on 2026-05-26. The page notes that the published text is abridged.

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: Section “(十四) 推进人工智能运用和智慧农业发展” calls for faster agricultural AI innovation and application, expanded use scenarios, agricultural/rural data infrastructure, large multimodal high-quality datasets and data standards, domestic software/hardware, increased computing capacity and an integrated sky–air–ground agricultural observation network. These are policy directions, not evidence of implementation or outcomes.

evidence_gaps.description: The accessible official ministry page states that the plan text is abridged; the full authoritative plan and implementation/budget instruments were not reviewed.

brief.importance_rationale: If implemented, a central five-year plan explicitly directing agricultural AI, datasets/data standards and computing capacity could shape sector planning and investment. Consequences remain bounded because the checked text provides no appropriations, deployment obligation or measured outcomes.
limitations: This is a central policy plan statement, not proof of funded commitments, local implementation, technical performance or realized economic impact.
The ministry page says that the plan text is abridged.
No appropriation, procurement record, local deployment, benchmark or independent outcome evaluation was inspected.
